Game Overview

In Cyborg II, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a futuristic battlefield as a skilled pilot in Cyborg II. Command a state-of-the-art aircraft, survive intense aerial combat, and annihilate mechanized foes with your weapon arsenal. Experience electrifying battles, strategic armory upgrades, and breathtaking visuals in this relentless quest to save humanity.
